raw_html.description: Full fetched HTML body, present only for successful text/html responses.

ai_crawler_access.description: Per-AI-crawler robots.txt verdict, {agent: allowed?}, for every agent in braiaudit.fetch.AI_CRAWLER_USER_AGENTS. Empty when no robots.txt was served.

blocked_ai_crawlers.description: Human-readable summary of which AI crawlers robots.txt disallows, and which classic search crawlers it still allows. Empty string when none are blocked.

internal_links.description: Absolute, deduplicated, same-host page links parsed from the static HTML. Feeds the crawl frontier and the link-graph checks without requiring the render backend.

schema_types.description: schema.org @type values found in the page's JSON-LD (Organization, Product, FAQPage, ...), used to judge structured-data completeness rather than mere presence.

structured_data_desync.description: Human-readable description of brand strings the JSON-LD asserts that do not appear in the visible page. Empty when structured data and rendered content agree.

anti_bot_evidence.description: What the bot-mitigation challenge actually looked like (status code plus matched fingerprint). Empty when no challenge was served.

brand_name_candidates.description: Brand names as stated by the page, most authoritative first. Feeds off-site entity lookup, where the right name variant decides whether a record is found at all.

http_error_evidence.description: What the error response looked like when a 4xx/5xx returned no usable body and no anti-bot fingerprint matched. Empty when the page was retrieved or a more specific check already explains the failure.

organization_legal_name.description: legalName declared by the page's own Organization JSON-LD. Empty when absent. This is what the site declares about itself, machine-read, not an external verification of the entity.

organization_same_as.description: sameAs URLs declared by the page's own Organization JSON-LD.

declared_brand_name.description: The brand name the site deliberately declares, from Organization.name or og:site_name only. Page <title> is excluded because it typically contains rather than states the brand. Empty when the site declares neither.

page_lang.description: Declared document language from the html lang attribute, or null when absent.

sitemap_skipped_children.description: Child sitemaps deliberately not expanded (nested index or cross-origin), with the reason.
